blocks.h2: When to Call for Drain Cleaning
blocks.body: Call when a plunger hasn't fixed it, when the same drain clogs again a few weeks later or when a drain smells like sewer. Notice how many fixtures are affected. One slow drain usually means a clog close to that fixture. If the basement floor drain fills when the washer runs, or the toilet bubbles when the tub drains, the clog is in the main line and calls for [sewer rodding](/elgin/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

bodies: Most clogs build from everyday use: hair and soap in the bathroom, grease and food in the kitchen, lint from the laundry. We clear them with a cable sized for the pipe and show you what came out.

In Elgin's older homes, drain pipes inside the walls may be galvanized steel or cast iron that has narrowed with age, so clogs come back faster. In newer west side homes, long runs between floors are where clogs settle. If the same drain keeps clogging, a camera look tells us whether it needs [hydro jetting](/elgin/hydro-jetting) or a repair.
Grease is behind most kitchen sink clogs. It goes down warm, cools in the pipe and grabs food scraps and soap until water stops moving.

If both sides of a double sink fill or the dishwasher drains into the sink, the clog is past the trap. We clear the line all the way to the stack and check the trap for leaks. If the disposal is involved, see [garbage disposal repair](/elgin/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Elgin Homes
blocks.intro: Elgin homes range from the 1800s to the last few years, so the reasons drains clog vary across the city.

items.body: Galvanized and cast iron drains in pre-1940 homes rust inside. The rough walls catch hair and grease, so clogs return quickly.
Larger households on the west side cook a lot, and grease builds up in kitchen lines over 20 or 30 years.
If several drains slow at once, roots in a clay lateral are a likely cause. That's [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When every drain slows down together or water comes up at the basement floor drain, the clog is in the main sewer drain. Clearing it takes a machine that can run the full line from the cleanout to the city main.

We clear the line and follow with a camera so you see the cause. In Elgin's older neighborhoods, it's usually roots at clay joints. In newer homes, it's more often grease, wipes or a sag. Repeat clogs get a plan: [sewer rodding](/elgin/sewer-rodding), [hydro jetting](/elgin/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/elgin/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: How do I know if it's a simple clog or a sewer problem?
items.preview: One slow fixture is a clog. Several, or the floor drain, is the main line.
items.answer: If only one sink, tub or toilet is slow, it's usually a local clog. If several fixtures are slow or water appears at the basement floor drain, the main sewer line is involved.

items.q: Why does my bathroom sink clog so often?
items.preview: Hair, soap and toothpaste build up in the trap and the pipe behind it.
items.answer: Hair, soap and toothpaste build up in the trap and the drain arm in the wall. In older homes, rough galvanized pipe makes it worse. A full cleaning of the line lasts longer than a quick snake.

items.q: Should I use a chemical drain cleaner first?
items.preview: We don't recommend it, especially on older pipe.
items.answer: We don't recommend it. Chemicals can damage older metal pipes and rarely clear the whole clog. They also make the job more dangerous for whoever clears it next.

items.q: Do you clean basement floor drains?
items.preview: Yes. They clog with lint, sediment and debris.
items.answer: Yes. Floor drains collect lint, sediment and debris over the years. If yours is slow or smells, we clear it and check the main line it connects to.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on the clog's location and cause. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. A bathroom sink is a different job than a main line. You get a flat price before any work begins.
